access.notes: Open-source DFT package. Any code supporting spin-polarized DFT with PAW pseudopotentials may be used.

resources.name: PBE PAW pseudopotentials for C, Si, Ge, Sn, Pb

access.notes: Standard Solid-State Pseudopotentials library (SSSP). Provide projector augmented-wave pseudopotentials generated for the Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) functional.

Publicly known crystal structure: primitive cell with hexagonal lattice constant 2.46 Å, basis atoms at (0,0,0) and (1/3,2/3,0). The agent constructs the 4×4×1 supercell from this standard information.
